name: event-kit
title: Event kit (countdown, add to calendar, .ics)
summary: A timezone-correct live countdown, a per-device Add to Calendar button, and a generated RFC 5545 .ics file, all from one event.json.
when: The site is for something that happens on a date: a fest, a launch, a hackathon, a wedding, a conference.
next: Fill in src/event/event.json (ISO times WITH the event's UTC offset, e.g. +05:30, never Z).
Run npm run event:ics once (it also runs before every build) and commit public/event.ics.
Render <Countdown /> and <AddToCalendar /> where the brief needs them.
